root.reorder: Reorders the root object keys to bomFormat, specVersion, serialNumber, version, metadata, components, annotations; any other keys follow them in their original relative order. Nested objects are not changed.
root.set_spec_version: Writes the value of the "Spec version" field (1.7 by default) into specVersion, trimming whitespace; adds the field if it was absent. A value outside 1.6/1.7 can be set, but the resulting document will be flagged as non-conforming.
root.remove_dependencies: Removes the root dependencies array entirely. The components themselves and their nested fields are not changed.
root.remove_services: Removes the root services array entirely. Components are not changed.
root.increment_version: Increments the integer version field by 1. If version is missing or is not an integer, the rule leaves it untouched and reports 0 changes.

metadata.reorder: Puts timestamp and component first; the remaining metadata keys follow in their original order. The content is not changed.
metadata.add_timestamp: Writes metadata.timestamp with the current UTC time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ format, only if the field is missing, null, or an empty string. An existing non-empty value is not overwritten.
metadata.remove_properties: Removes the document's own properties (metadata.properties). Component properties are not affected by this rule.
metadata.remove_tools: Removes metadata.tools in any form — both an array and an object.

metadata_component.reorder: Puts type, name, version, manufacturer first, then the remaining keys in their original order.
metadata_component.remove_external_references: Removes metadata.component.externalReferences entirely. Component external references in components[] are not affected by this rule.
metadata_component.remove_properties: Removes metadata.component.properties. Component properties in components[] are not affected by this rule.
metadata_component.remove_purl: Removes purl only from metadata.component. purl values of components in components[] are preserved. The rule is disabled by default.
metadata_component.remove_scope: Removes scope only from metadata.component. The scope of components in components[] is handled by a separate rule.
metadata_component.rename_supplier: Removes supplier and moves its value to manufacturer, only if manufacturer is missing or null. If manufacturer is already set, supplier is simply removed.

components.reorder: Sets each component's keys to the order type, name, version, purl, externalReferences, properties, components, then the remaining keys in their original order. Applied recursively to nested components. metadata.component is not affected.
components.remove_hashes: Removes the component's own hashes field. Hashes inside externalReferences (for example, on a distribution link) are preserved.
components.remove_scope: Removes the scope field from every component in components[], recursively. metadata.component.scope is handled by a separate rule.
components.filter_external_references: Keeps only externalReferences entries whose type is exactly vcs or source-distribution (case-sensitive). Other types (website, distribution, issue-tracker, etc.) are removed; if nothing remains, the array stays empty. metadata.component is not affected.
components.filter_properties: Keeps only properties entries whose name starts exactly with GOST: (case-sensitive). The rest are removed; an empty array stays empty. metadata.component is not affected.
components.fill_missing_gost_properties: Adds the missing GOST:attack_surface and GOST:security_function properties with the value "no" to the component. Creates the array if properties is missing; existing properties are not changed. The rule is disabled by default; metadata.component is not affected.

urlValidation.title: URL Validation
urlValidation.validateDbUrlsDesc: When enabled, repository URLs found in the local database are verified (HTTP HEAD + VCS check) before being returned. Invalid URLs are deleted and resolution continues through the resolver chain.
urlValidation.validateSbomRefsDesc: When enabled, existing VCS URLs found in SBOM files are verified before enrichment. Invalid URLs trigger re-resolution of the component.
urlValidation.multipleVcs: Behavior when multiple valid VCS-links are found
urlValidation.multipleVcsDesc: When multiple valid VCS references are found in the SBOM for a component, choose whether to keep only the first one or all of them in the externalReferences list.
urlValidation.timeoutDesc: Timeout for each HTTP-HEAD and VCS-check query (1–60 seconds).
urlValidation.cooldownDesc: This setting controls how long a successfully validated URL remains in the validation cache before being re-checked. All validated URLs are treated equally regardless of origin (resolver, import, or database). Set to 0 to disable the cache and always re-validate.
urlValidation.infoText: URLs from resolvers are always validated before being returned. Validation results are cached and reused across all contexts (local database, SBOM enrichment) within the configured cooldown period.
urlValidation.clearCacheDesc: Remove all cached URL validation results. The next validation for each URL will perform a full check.

librariesio.title: Resolver "Libraries.io"
librariesio.enableDesc: When enabled, libraries.io is used as a fallback resolver when purl2repo cannot find a repository URL.
librariesio.apiKeyDesc: Optional API key for higher rate limits (60 req/min vs 10 req/min).
librariesio.loginHint: Log in to libraries.io → Settings → API Key

apkResolver.title: Resolver "APK" (Alpine Linux)
apkResolver.enableDesc: When enabled, Alpine Linux APK packages (pkg:apk/...) resolve to https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports as a fallback.

llmResolver.title: LLM Resolver
llmResolver.enableDesc: When enabled and all other resolvers fail, an LLM with web-search/web-fetch tools is asked for the source repository. The returned URL is verified with an HTTP HEAD request before use.
llmResolver.baseUrlDesc: HTTP endpoint of the LLM API in OpenAI format, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com
llmResolver.apiKeyDesc: API key for the LLM endpoint.
llmResolver.attemptsCountDesc: Total number of LLM requests per PURL, including the first one. On a rejected answer (bad JSON, mismatched PURL, invalid or unreachable URL) the model receives feedback and is asked to retry. Default: 2. Range: 1–10.
llmResolver.timeoutDesc: Timeout for each LLM request and HTTP HEAD check (1–600 seconds). Default: 60.

ecosystems.title: Resolver "Ecosyste.ms"
ecosystems.enableDesc: Live query to ecosyste.ms API for repository URL lookup. Works without API key. Key is optional for higher rate limits.
ecosystems.apiKeyDesc: Optional API key for higher rate limits.
ecosystems.loginHint: Log in to ecosyste.ms → Account → API Key
ecosystems.maxRpsDesc: Rate limit for ecosyste.ms API requests (0.1–100 req/s). Default: 2.0. Lower values reduce timeout risk under concurrent load.

resolverBehaviour.title: Resolver Behaviour
resolverBehaviour.maxRetriesDesc: Maximum HTTP request attempts per resolver (including the first). Applied to ecosyste.ms and libraries.io on timeout, rate limit (429), and server errors (5xx). Default: 3. Range: 1–10.
resolverBehaviour.cooldownDesc: Base wait time between retries. Actual wait = cooldown × (attempt − 1). Example: cooldown=5 → waits 5s before 2nd attempt, 10s before 3rd. Range: 0.5–120 seconds.

jobManagement.title: Job Management
jobManagement.ttlDesc: Completed, cancelled, and failed jobs are automatically deleted after this many hours.

network.title: Network & Performance
network.batchLimitDesc: Maximum number of parallel PURL resolution requests in a batch (1–100). Default: 10.
network.batchMaxItemsDesc: Maximum number of PURLs accepted in a single resolve request (1–1000). Default: 100.
network.probeUrlDesc: Target URL used to check internet access before URL validation. Set to empty to disable the probe.
network.probeTimeoutDesc: Timeout for the connectivity HEAD request (1–30 seconds). Default: 2.

logging.title: Logging
logging.logLevelDesc: Controls which log messages are shown in docker compose logs. DEBUG – all messages, INFO – general operations, WARNING – errors only.

jsonFormat.title: JSON Format
jsonFormat.indentSizeDesc: Number of spaces used when indenting JSON in downloaded files (SBOM, Images List).

depsdevResolver.title: deps.dev Resolver
depsdevResolver.enableDesc: When enabled, packages supported by deps.dev (Maven, npm, Go, PyPI, NuGet, Cargo, RubyGems) are resolved through the deps.dev API as the second step of the resolver chain.
